Incentives for Homebuyers and Water Conservation Highlighted

Two separate reports highlight financial incentives related to homeownership and property. One focuses on a 10% property tax rebate in Indore for homeowners who conserve water, linking environmental action to financial benefit. Another discusses various state-level stamp duty reductions and preferential home loan rates aimed at women buyers, supported by government housing schemes.
